record:
change_definition:
  current_behavior: "Clients can generate evidence-chain-profile.v1; [REQ-EVIDENCE_CHAIN_PROFILE] lists cross-project cohort aggregation as a non-goal and no TIED-side batch report exists."
  desired_behavior: "A TIED-source offline CLI reads an evidence-chain-report-inputs.v1 manifest and already-generated profile artifacts, partitions client cohorts by schema_version and profile_depth, and writes evidence-chain-statistics-report.v1 YAML plus a deterministic Markdown projection."
  non_goals:
    - "Generate or regenerate evidence-chain-profile.v1"
    - "Read or mutate client repositories, project YAML, finding ledgers, or case reports"
    - "Universal maturity score or cross-cohort numeric rollup"
    - "Sum or average derived-field values in v1"
    - "Treat TIED_MCP_COLLECT_METRICS as evidence-chain results"
    - "Promote [REQ-EVIDENCE_CHAIN_REPORT] into templates/"
  success_criteria:
    - "Byte-stable YAML and Markdown for fixed inputs and clock"
    - "Incompatible depths remain separate client cohorts"
    - "Missing evidence is never coerced to zero"
    - "Forbidden maturity and score fields reject the artifact"
    - "strict mode writes no outputs when any input is rejected"
  unchanged_behavior: "Profile generation, fidelity first-slice, quality manifests, and opt-in usage metrics remain independent."
completion_criteria:
  verification_gate_notes: "Refine-plan authored TIED R+A+I, IMPL sidecar, vocab, guide contract, and this draft CITDP. TypeScript aggregator and CHANGELOG wait for /build-plan."
